key_points: U.S. Treasury deferred diesel taxes until 2026, lowering federal fuel tax burden.
Trump authorized temporary highway use of dyed diesel, supporting diesel demand.
Valero as a major refiner stands to gain from higher diesel volumes and lower tax costs.
VLO rose ~3% on Oct 5, hitting a new 12‑month high after an analyst upgrade.
Options data show heightened put/call activity but no material change in fundamentals.
